description: Retrieve one artwork in full: technical specification, availability, price, the physics measured from its master, and, when available, the curatorial capsule. Given the buyer's country and type, it also shows the exact total for that buyer. Accepts the identifier or the title — and when a title belongs to more than one work, it returns them all rather than guessing.

buyer_country.description: Optional. Where the private buyer lives, or where the company is based (not their nationality): two-letter code (ISO 3166-1), such as ES, FR or US.

buyer_postal_code.description: Needed for a buyer in Spain or in another EU country: some territories there have their own taxes (such as the Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla, Åland, the Azores, Madeira or the French overseas departments).

buyer_type.description: Optional, with buyer_country. person: a private buyer. company: a business or professional buying for its activity. Ask the buyer; never assume it.

name.description: Artwork identifier, or its name. An ambiguous name returns every candidate.

name: get_artwork
title: Get artwork
